metadata.description: Matt Stvartak's Claude Code skill library

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Project onboarding: a natural interview with a coverage tracker that turns an app idea or an existing codebase into a full SOW, then hands off to design and build.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Premium web and app design: brief interview, taste picker, token system, prototype, production build and screenshot verification.

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Runs a build phase from blueprint's plan with parallel Sonnet workers in separate worktrees, merges into one integration branch with an Opus integrator for conflicts, and closes with a nitpick review.

plugins.name: founder
plugins.description: A founder for your agent teams: turns your vision into a vision doc and ambitious phase briefs on top of blueprint's SOW, collects the teams' questions, and works through every open detail with you.

plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: One command to start or resume a project: finds the stage from the project's docs and runs founder, blueprint, craft and foreman in order, pausing at the calls that are yours.

plugins.name: napkin
plugins.description: Lazy senior architect mode, always on: the fewest components that meet the real requirements, sized for today's scale and written down with when to revisit.

plugins.name: nitpick
plugins.description: Strict code review from an opinionated senior dev who nitpicks everything: readable names, clean organization, no repetition, reuse of existing helpers, mainstream libraries over niche ones.

plugins.name: pager
plugins.description: Lazy senior DevOps mode, always on: the fewest moving parts that fully solve the infrastructure task, with a verified rollout and a way back.

plugins.name: proof
plugins.description: Two on-demand engineering disciplines: test-first red to green one slice at a time, and a gated loop for diagnosing hard bugs and performance regressions.

plugins.name: reel
plugins.description: Rebuilds a feature of your app as an animated HTML film for a marketing page, with a live embed and exported video, instead of a screen recording.

plugins.name: trim
plugins.description: Lazy senior developer mode, always on: the smallest complete change that solves the task, with every deliberate shortcut marked and its limit written down.
